{{Quote|I'm Juda, Nem'ro's paymaster. If he gives you work, I'm the one you settle up with when the job's done.|Juda|<ref name="TOR:BC">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Big Chief|Hutta}}</ref>}}
'''Juda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked for [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] as his paymaster.<ref name="TOR:BC" /> She paid a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] several times for his bounties.<ref name="TOR:BCHR" /><ref name="TOR:SAYR">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Settling Accounts: Yalt Reward|Hutta}}</ref><ref name="TOR:HCNA">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|House Cleaning: Nem'ro's Apology|Hutta}}</ref> Juda later helped [[Bilikin Drell]] set up an auction on Hutta for the target list of the Great Hunt, but later contacted the Mandalorians after learning what the subject of the auction was. She was then confronted by the Hunter for her involvement.<ref name="TOR:ADA">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|A Dangerous Auction|Hutta}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Juda is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:BCHR" /> She is voiced by [[Kath Soucie]].

If the Hunter is male, Juda is one of many flirt options the player can engage in, although it never progresses very far.<ref name="TOR:BC" />
